key_insight: Injecting prepared logical resource states enables addressable, parallel universal fault-tolerant computation in high-rate concatenated quantum codes.
engineering_relevance: The architecture combines logical gates with error correction and bounds resource-state consumption at no more than 12D_T for algorithms with T-depth D_T.
method: Flexibly concatenate small-distance, high-rate self-dual CSS codes.
Prepare logical CSS stabilizer states using flag-at-origin and global magic states using concatenated cultivation.
Consume these resources through Steane-QEC or Knill-QEC teleportation gadgets.
evidence_signal: Resource-preparation benchmarks for several two-level concatenations of H codes and the [[15,7,3]] Hamming code report at least a tenfold spacetime reduction for concatenated cultivation versus surface-code cultivation.
watch_item: The reported advantage concerns resource-state preparation; end-to-end hardware costs and connectivity requirements still need assessment.
paper_title: Injection is all you need: parallel universal logic in high-rate concatenated self-dual codes
